source: SharePoint /5. Marketing/BrandBook26 - Generations/Generations - Brand Guidelines - V02.pdf

generations.label: Generations (marque mère)
generations.use_when: Multi-service pages, corporate umbrella, mother-brand hero
generations.role: Umbrella. Uses hero-mesh with all sub-brand gradients together.

recruitment.label: Recruitment
recruitment.use_when: Standard permanent recruitment offers, sourcing services, job pages
recruitment.role: Blue = trust, expertise. Same family as Committer GRAM.

rpo.label: RPO Solutions
rpo.use_when: RPO proposals, client hubs (Hedgren, CEFTA, Aqvita, Abbove), delivery portals, RPO tenders
rpo.role: Magenta/pink = the flagship service line. High visual signature.

executive.label: Executive Search
executive.use_when: C-suite / senior placements, exec confidential mandates, board-level searches
executive.role: Gold = premium, sophistication. Same family as Harmonizer GRAM.

interim.label: Interim Management
interim.role: Orange = energy, momentum, action. Same family as Emancipator GRAM.

worktech.label: WorkTech Solutions
worktech.use_when: Product minisites, client portals, agents, Sales Companion, background checker, dashboards, tech demos
worktech.role: Green-teal-to-lime = growth, tech, freshness. Same family as Trendsetter GRAM.

gram.label: GRAM by Generations
gram.use_when: Psychometric reports, candidate assessments, profile pages, GRAM product
gram.role: Meta-brand: each profile has its own gradient (see gram_profiles). Violet is the default GRAM cover.

dark_shell.notes: Dark canvas remains the Generations minisite standard. The sub-brand accent replaces the previous coral placeholder.

light_shell.notes: Use only when brand mandates a printable/executive look (Executive Search reports, GRAM PDFs). Default = dark.

logo_assets.structure: {sub_brand}/{variant}.{ext} — variants: color, color-h (horizontal), color-it (icon+text), white, white-text, white-it, bw, icon

usage_rules.hero_choice: The hero gradient signals what the page is about. RPO hub = rpo. WorkTech product = worktech. Multi-service corporate = generations mother mesh.
usage_rules.no_mixing: Never mix two sub-brand primaries as equal accents on the same page. Sub-brand is the accent; other brands appear only as secondary chips or logos.
usage_rules.gram_special: GRAM pages may use all 7 profile gradients simultaneously (that's the point). Elsewhere: one gradient rules.
usage_rules.dark_canvas: Default dark shell (#06060a). Cards use glass surfaces. The sub-brand gradient appears in hero mesh, primary CTA, section top-borders, and hover glows.
usage_rules.type_hierarchy: Inter for everything except numbers, KPIs, tickers, and small badges — those use JetBrains Mono.
never: Light theme without a brand reason
